pack.title: Sarcasm in text
pack.description: Repair a joke that did not land.

scenarios.setting: Your joking message lands badly and a colleague tells you it hurt.
scenarios.jab: Was that meant to be funny? It sounded pretty rude.
scenarios.goal: Repair a joke that did not land.

replies.line: You're right; that came across badly. I'm sorry.
replies.why: It owns the impact without making the reader responsible for misunderstanding.
replies.delivery: Write the apology plainly; avoid adding an emoji that makes the repair feel dismissive.

replies.why: It offers a direct apology without an excuse.
replies.delivery: Write the apology plainly; avoid adding an emoji that makes the repair feel dismissive.

replies.line: I meant it lightly, but I see it hurt; I'm sorry, and I won't repeat it.
replies.why: It acknowledges both intention and impact while committing to a change.
replies.delivery: Write the apology plainly; avoid adding an emoji that makes the repair feel dismissive.

followUp.jab: Then why did you send it?
followUp.line: I misjudged it; that's on me, and I'll be more careful.
followUp.why: It accepts responsibility without asking the recipient to reassure you.
followUp.delivery: Write the apology plainly; avoid adding an emoji that makes the repair feel dismissive.
